video.title: Roadmap to learn DevOps faster in less than 6 months #devops #cloudcomputing

transcript.text: three ways to learn and master devops in
less than six months number one is clear
your Basics make sure you have strong
foundational knowledge on Concepts like
Linux git networking also familiarize
yourself with different devops tools
like terraform Docker kubernetes and
understand their role in the devops
workflow
number two is learn by doing make sure
you do as much Hands-On as you can along
with the theory while learning devops
some Hands-On exercises may include
deploying an application setting up
automation managing infrastructure and
much more number three is projects and
certifications after you have learned
something you can validate your learning
by giving certifications or creating
projects that can build your resume and
also land you a devop shop
